english.title: Publish an image of an item of clothing or other article - terrorism

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Counter Terrorism and Border Security Act 2019

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), published an image of an

(A)_[item of clothing,]_
(B)_[article,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY DETAILS..), in such a way or in such circumstances as to arouse reasonable suspicion that you were a member or supporter of a proscribed organisation, namely **(..SPECIFY ORGANISATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 13(1A) and (3) of the Terrorism Act 2000.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) The consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions or the Attorney General is required, see section 117 of the Terrorism Act 2000.
(ii) See Schedule 2 for a list of proscribed organisations.
(iii) This offence applies to acts done outside the United Kingdom regardless of the nationality of the offender, see section 17.
(iv) For UK-wide jurisdiction for this offence regardless of where it took place see section 28 of the Counter-Terrorism Act 2008.

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

For offences committed on or after 12th March 2015 the fine on summary conviction is unlimited, see section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012.
